title: Markdown
summary: A read-only view of Markdown text, drawn with the toolkit's own parser and renderer (the one behind pk-markdown-editor's preview): DOM calls only, so raw HTML is shown as text, a link must be http, https, mailto or a relative address, and nothing from the source becomes markup. The Markdown subset is paragraphs, bold, italic, code, fenced code, headings 1 to 3, quotes, lists and links. A click on a relative link raises pk-link-click, so the app routes or rewrites it. Use it instead of writing rendered HTML into the page yourself.

props.name: markdown
props.description: The Markdown text to show. Text longer than 200000 characters is cut and a note is added.

props.name: interceptLinks
props.description: Cancel the click on a relative link (not an #anchor, not an absolute address) so the page does not navigate; pk-link-click still reports its address. Without it the link navigates unless a pk-link-click listener calls preventDefault. A click with a modifier key or a middle click is left to the browser.

events.name: pk-link-click
events.description: A relative link was clicked: href is its address as written. Cancel it (preventDefault), or set interceptLinks, to route or rewrite it yourself.

a11y: Headings, lists, quotes and links are real elements, so the text keeps its structure for assistive technology; a heading takes its place in the page outline.
